name: [Update2.2] Dinosaur Survival
desc:
[Update 3.2] 
+  Hitboxs 🦖 



Welcome to Dinosaur Survival! 

Explore the map with different dinosaurs and collect coins found around, 
or kill Dryosaurus NPCs and other dinosaurs to earn coins to wear more dinosaurs! 

How to: Go up to the changeboard of a specific dinosaur and transform into a dinosaur! Then, click Roar, Attack.
